subject: general
question: Parakram Diwas is observed every year on January 23 to commemorate the birth anniversary of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose. In 2026, Parakram Diwas marked his __________ birth anniversary.
solution:
The correct answer is __**129th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Parakram Diwas 2026 marked the 129th birth anniversary of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• Parakram Diwas is observed every year on **January 23**.
 
• The day commemorates the birth anniversary of **Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose**.
 
• The year **2026 marked his 129th birth anniversary**.
 
• The observance honours his courage, discipline, and leadership as the founder of the **Indian National Army (INA)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Parakram Diwas**__

 __
 
• Declared by the Government of India in **2021**
 
• Aims to inspire citizens with values of **valour, sacrifice, and national spirit**
 
 
 
• **Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose**__
 
 
• Founder of the **Indian National Army (INA)**
 
• A prominent leader of India’s freedom struggle
 
• Known for his slogan: **“Give me blood, and I shall give you freedom”**
